if: the fifty per cent. restriction under s.17(4) would otherwise apply
the supply was made by one registered person to another registered person having the SAME Permanent Account Number
then: the fifty per cent. restriction does NOT apply to the tax paid on that supply
note: Same-PAN intra-entity supplies — typically between branches registered in different States — escape the fifty per cent. haircut entirely. The test is identity of PAN, not of GSTIN. The source is the CGST Act as updated 31-08-2021. UNKNOWN whether a later amendment has changed this provision; later amendments are not held locally.

evidence.quote: Provided further that the restriction of fifty per cent. shall not apply to the tax paid
